WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2,3), paid AS (SELECT p.payer_class, r.payment_date - p.first_sub AS d FROM prim p JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication WHERE r.paid_amount>0)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS paid_claims, ROUND(MEDIAN(d),1) AS median_days, ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(d,0.9),1) AS p90_days FROM paid GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.remit_claim_id=a.remit_claim_id AND r.is_denied) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

WITH ev AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class, COUNT(*) AS n, BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS ok FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS pairs_remitted, SUM(CASE WHEN n=1 AND ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_pass, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN n=1 AND ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS rate_pct FROM ev GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH g AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class, COUNT(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS ntr, BOOL_OR(is_reversal) AS rev, BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current_adjudication THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS pairs, SUM(CASE WHEN rev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_reversal, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT cur THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_current, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(paid),0),2) AS current_paid FROM g WHERE ntr>=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT service_month, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month>=DATE '2026-06-01'),
r AS (SELECT service_month, referring_npi, COUNT(*) n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, referring_npi) rk FROM c GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT strftime(service_month,'%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(n) AS total_claims, SUM(CASE WHEN rk<=5 THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS top5_claims, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rk<=5 THEN n ELSE 0 END)/SUM(n),1) AS top5_share_pct FROM r GROUP BY service_month ORDER BY service_month
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN procedure_code='87798' THEN line_paid_amount ELSE 0 END)/SUM(line_paid_amount),4) AS share FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH cp AS (SELECT DISTINCT cl.procedure_code, r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN sem.claim_lines cl ON cl.claim_key=r.claim_key AND cl.payer_key=r.payer_key AND cl.is_latest_submission WHERE r.is_current_adjudication)
SELECT procedure_code, COUNT(*) AS adjudications, SUM(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS denial_rate_pct FROM cp GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>=20 ORDER BY denial_rate_pct DESC, procedure_code

WITH c AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND payer_responsibility='P')
SELECT CASE WHEN line_count=1 THEN '1' WHEN line_count=2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS claims, SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS rate_pct, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_denied THEN c.charge_amount END),0) AS denied_charge
FROM c JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=c.claim_key AND r.payer_key=c.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT reference_id, payer_key, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount amt FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code='FB')
SELECT c.reference_id, c.payment_date AS carried_date, ROUND(-c.amt,2) AS amount, MIN(o.payment_date) AS offset_date, DATEDIFF('day', c.payment_date, MIN(o.payment_date)) AS days
FROM f c LEFT JOIN f o ON o.reference_id=c.reference_id AND o.payer_key=c.payer_key AND o.amt=-c.amt AND o.payment_date>c.payment_date WHERE c.amt<0 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,1
